K_lambda.definition: K_lambda: E = (1/2) sum_a [sum_i (d_i lambda_a)^2 + omega^2 (d_t lambda_a)^2], lambda_a eigenvalues of N = M eta, d_mu lambda_a = (v_a^T eta A_mu eta v_a)/(v_a^T eta v_a)

R_eta.definition: R_G with G = eta: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

R_etaMeta.definition: R_G with G = etaMeta: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

R_Minv.definition: R_G with G = Minv: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

R_hcov.definition: R_G with G = hcov: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

K_P_h.definition: K_P^h (H-adjoint form, the author's 2026-09-05 correction, invariant order): E = (1/2)[sum_i tr(Om_i^T H Om_i H^-1) + omega^2 tr(Om_0^T H Om_0 H^-1)], Om_mu = P A_mu eta P, H = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T, H^-1 = eta + 2 u u^T; = the Frobenius norm of the projected jet in the eta-orthonormal eigenbasis (PSD everywhere)

K_P.definition: K_P: E = (1/2)[sum_i tr((P A_i eta P)^2) + omega^2 tr((P a0 eta P)^2)], N = M eta, P = (N - lambda_t)(N - 1), lambda_t the timelike eigenvalue of the vacuum (-g)
